# Step - is

`is` · `is_` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps values equal to the given value or matching the predicate.

## Forms

```text
is(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("age").is(P.lt(30)).to_list()   // [29, 27]
```
